citation.title: Mechanical Ventilation Guided by Esophageal Pressure in Acute Lung Injury

provenance.quote: We performed the trial in the medical and surgical intensive care units (ICUs) of Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center in Boston.
Airway pressure, tidal volume, and air flow were recorded during mechanical ventilation.
provenance.location: Methods, Measurements and Experimental Protocol, p. 2096

provenance.quote: We performed the trial in the medical and surgical intensive care units (ICUs) of Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center in Boston.

PEEP levels were set to achieve a transpulmonary pressure of 0 to 10 cm of water at end expiration, according to a sliding scale based on the partial pressure of arterial oxygen (PaO2) and the fraction of inspired oxygen (FiO2) (Fig. 1).

The secondary end points included indexes of lung mechanics and gas exchange (respiratory-system compliance and the ratio of physiological dead space to tidal volume), as well as outcomes of the patients (the number of ventilator-free days at 28 days, length of stay in the ICU, and death within 28 days and 180 days after treatment).
The study reached its stopping criterion and was terminated after 61 patients had been enrolled.
We report the results of a randomized, controlled pilot trial involving patients with acute lung injury or ARDS.

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_subgroup: population enrolled with ALI or ARDS by AECC; 49/61 (80%) met ARDS criteria (PaO2:FiO2 <200), so mixed_some_ards. obesity_subgroup: BMI not reported; predicted body weight only. timing_subgroup: no reference event or interval from intubation/ICU admission/ARDS onset reported. ptp_target_subgroups: absolute Pes subtraction with end-expiratory Ptp target 0 to 10 cmH2O. is_longest_reported_mortality set on the 180-day mortality entry because 180 days outranks 28 days.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: COHORTS.md lists talmor_2008 (primary, NEJM, n=61, NCT00127491) and baedorf_kassis_2016 as the epvent1 cluster; baedorf_kassis_2016 states that 56 patients from a previous study were analysed. Trial registration NCT00127491 and single centre (Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston) match the cluster description. This record is the primary report.
unclear_items: design.countries: inferred from 'Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center in Boston'; the paper does not state the country.
design.n_centers: single centre stated in prose ('single-center study') but no numeric count given; left null.
design.allocation_ratio: block randomisation stated but ratio not reported.
eligibility.criteria.adults_18_plus: no explicit age criterion stated; coded yes on the adult ICU setting per codebook ruling.

feasibility.n_placement_attempted / n_placement_successful: balloon passage described for all patients but exact counts of attempted and successful placement not reported; only 'approximately one third' could not be passed into the stomach.
intervention.timing: no reference event or interval reported for when balloon-guided management began relative to intubation or ICU admission.
population.n_enrolled vs Table 2 denominators: Table 2 reports N=29 per arm at 72 hours (survivors); n_analysed recorded as 61 per intention-to-treat statement.

arms[pes_guided].peep_applied_cmh2o: mean 18.7±5.1 reported at 24 hours with denominator stated as '3 of the 31 patients' in the same sentence, although Table 1 gives N=30 for this arm; denominator ambiguity flagged.
